header.title: Getting started
header.description: Install the package, load the styles and start using Gem System components.

peers.title: Peers
peers.body: React 18.2+ or 19. Table also requires @tanstack/react-table and @tanstack/react-virtual.

bootstrap.title: Bootstrap
bootstrap.description: The fastest way: import styles.css once in your entry and use the components from the barrel.

partial.title: Import only what you need
partial.description: You don't have to load the whole design system. Each component is published as its own subpath (in kebab-case, e.g. @gem-org/gem-system/date-picker) with a matching stylesheet (date-picker.css). That way the bundle only includes the JS and CSS of the components you actually use.
partial.label: Partial import

notes.tokens: tokens.css is required and imported only once: it defines the --gem-* variables used by every component.
notes.utilities: utilities.css is optional; only if you use utility classes such as gem-bg-* or gem-text-*.
notes.dependencies: Components don't import CSS on their own: the app loads the styles. If a component uses another one internally (Button uses Icon), also import that dependency's styles.
notes.single: Pick one path: styles.css already includes every style, don't mix it with individual imports.

fonts.title: Fonts
fonts.description: The typefaces (Fraunces, Manrope and JetBrains Mono) are loaded in the HTML head.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Gem System ships light and dark themes. The theme is controlled with the data-theme attribute or with the helpers from @gem-org/gem-system/tokens.

code.scopedTheme: The theme can also be applied to a single container
